Chapter 6663: Master Of Life And Death

Chapter 6663: Master Of Life And Death

In terms of an immortal tribulation, others only had to surpass one while she faced a thousand consecutive waves.

The high heaven didn’t permit someone else to interfere with life and death. Although she managed to evade any punishment, the immortal ascension made it impossible. All the accumulated punishments occurred simultaneously.

The immortals themselves felt fear. For example, Bao Pu had survived his immortal tribulation. Alas, he believed he had no chance of surviving this one.

“My fate is my own!” Lord of Life and Death activated her overlord cultivation.

Unfortunately, the tribulations decided otherwise. The karmic retribution astounded everyone but she kept up. She was the master of life and death and kept death away.

Her incredible ability left the supreme overlords in awe. She somehow endured the high heaven’s wrath.

Suddenly, everyone thought perhaps her title had nothing to do with her ability to swap life and death. It was because she could resist the high heaven’s will.

“How is she doing this?” Weizhen was left speechless.

“Thorough comprehension of life and death.” Bao Pu murmured.

Alas, how long could she keep this up? The bolts still struck her, painting her dress red with blood. It would not stop until her true fate’s destruction yet she proudly stood.

She relied on her understanding of life and death instead of weapons and treasures.

Meanwhile, all cultivators below the immortal realm were suppressed by the tribulations. They could only watch the frail cultivator survive amidst the lightning ocean.

In their eyes, she was massive like a supreme lord. Her body exploding and true fate being damaged couldn’t cause her to frown.

Before this, most believed Xian Chengtian was the strongest overlord, the number one cultivator beneath the immortal realm. Now, spectators respected her tenacity and changed their minds.

If they had the opportunity to see her going all-out, they would have never made that claim. She, yet an immortal, was somehow superior to one.

“Boom!” The current wave blasted her flesh, revealing the bones beneath before breaking them.

She still didn’t frown and stood with her back straight, displaying her peerless determination to rebel against the high heaven.

As the bolts became stronger, the tides began to shift. The broken parts of her body began to glow with an immortal light. Each piercing bolt somehow created an immortal ray.

“It’s happening!” Spectators became excited to witness an immortal ascension.

“This is the key moment.” Weizhen and Supreme Black Ancestor understood.

“Now.” Bao Pu took one step forward, wanting to end her.

“!” Guardian Blade of Life and Death became alarmed.

“Bao Pu!” Supreme Black Ancestor shouted.

Alas, Weizhen and Primal Yin Immortal Ghost blocked their way.

“Buzz.” Life and Death Heaven released primordial rays, creating barriers made from numerous affinities and arranged in harmony with the dao.

“Not enough to stop me.” Bao Pu still broke through after activating a radiant flame. Each step took down one barrier layer. They shattered like glass.

“Bao Pu is coming!” Spectators shouted.
